title: Counting a key present in a settings file, and diff-marker lines, over its chezmoi diff is allowed

fixtures.name: present settings key count plus diff-marker count over a chezmoi diff

tool_input.command: echo "present key lines in chezmoi diff: $(chezmoi diff ~/.claude/settings.json | grep -c DISABLE_TELEMETRY)"; echo "total changed lines in chezmoi diff: $(chezmoi diff ~/.claude/settings.json | grep -cE '^[-+][^-+]')"
